lines: Regions Bank operates at super-regional bank scale across five key dimensions:

Key operational metrics: 1,253 branches | 1,850+ ATMs | ~23,000 associates | 56% efficiency ratio (best-in-class regional bank) | 200K hours saved through process centralization | 30%+ organic deposit growth 5-year CAGR vs. peers (top-quartile) | New native mobile app launched July 2025. Evidence: E-035, E-058, E-059, E-084.

5-year CAGR (net income 2020–2025): +16.2%. Efficiency ratio: 56% (best-in-class regional bank). Technology investment sustained at 9–11% of revenue (~$400–500M annually) through 2027. Q2 2025: $1.9B total revenue | $0.60 adjusted EPS | +12% YoY net income. 30%+ organic deposit growth vs. peers over 5 years (top quartile). Capital markets revenue: 14% CAGR since 2019. Evidence: E-035, E-058, E-059, E-084.

firmographics.narrative_md:
Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE: RF) is a publicly traded bank holding company incorporated in Delaware and headquartered at 1900 Fifth Avenue North, Birmingham, Alabama. Founded in 1971, Regions Financial Corporation is the parent company of Regions Bank — an Alabama state-chartered commercial bank and member of the Federal Reserve System. As a Bank Holding Company (BHC) supervised by the Federal Reserve under the Bank Holding Company Act, Regions Financial submits annual 10-K filings and CCAR stress test results to the Federal Reserve.

Regions Bank holds FDIC deposit insurance and is jointly examined by the Federal Reserve and Alabama Banking Department. Dan Massey (Chief Enterprise Operations and Technology Officer) joined from Truist Bank in May 2022 and reports directly to CEO John Turner. As of March 31, 2026, Anil Chadha serves as Chief Financial Officer, succeeding David Turner who retired after 20 years. Evidence: E-001, E-007, E-009, E-058.
